messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty → PAGER: inference-api-eu fired (P1). Symptom: sustained tail latency > 5s and 500s spiking. PagerDuty incident PD-9482. Please ack.

ben_oncall: Acked. I'm taking this.

alice_dev: Ben — can you confirm customer-visible error rate? Any 5xx increase?

ben_oncall: Checking dashboards... one sec

ben_oncall: Grafana: https://grafana.internal/r/inf-high-latency 
Short-term: request queue depth increased on pool-gpu-3, kvcache evicts causing fetch retries.

carol_sre: Noted. Is this affecting Dedicated pools or hosted API only?

ben_oncall: Both; hosted API has ~3% 5xx increase, a couple Dedicated tenants reporting timeouts. Adding runbook steps.

ben_oncall: Runbook steps:
1) scale up pool-gpu-3 by +2 replicas
2) enable fallback model-route for latency-sensitive routes
3) clear prefix cache on suspect nodes
Commands:
```
kubectl scale deploy/inf-pool-gpu-3 --replicas=6 -n prod
redwood route update --id latency-route --fallback small-model-v2
```

dave_support: I'll notify impacted customers in #support-esc and post a status page update.

alice_dev: Ben, if you handoff, ping me in 30m. Otherwise I'll take post-mitigation RCA.

ben_oncall: Scaling now.
Scaled to 6.
Started fallback route.
Eviction clear in progress.

incidentbot: Automation: autoscaler fired scale event +1 replica 20s ago (logged).

ben_oncall: 5xx starting to trend down to baseline. Latency tail improving. Marking as acknowledged, monitoring.

carol_sre: If stable for 15m, let's plan rollback of fallback and open follow-up ticket for kvcache thrash.

dave_support: Posted customer PSA: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/PD-9482

ben_oncall: Confirmed 18m stable window. Handing off to alice_dev for RCA and postmortem. @alice_dev — takeover.

alice_dev: Taking it. Opening postmortem checklist and assigning to infra team. Thanks team :thumbsup:
